# FDG8006

> DO apply the `AttributeUsageAttribute` to custom attributes.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.2 Attributes.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1018
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

CA1018 reports a non-abstract attribute class that neither declares AttributeUsageAttribute nor inherits it from a base attribute (probe with SDK 10.0.402: a sealed attribute derived from an attribute with AttributeUsage was not reported, and neither was an abstract attribute). The SDK lists a code fix, but dotnet format applied none in the probe, so autofix is no.

## From the book

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(...)]
public class ObsoleteAttribute{}
```
